NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author updated the PR description with `/emails` screenshots (HTML and text, for both password-enabled and SSO-only realms) and added the self-review checklist. There was no new push, and none was needed, since both asks were about the description.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Screenshots from the dev `/emails` page are in the description, covering HTML and text in both cases. |
| ✅  | The self-review checklist is now in the main PR description. |

**Reviewer:** laurynmm — gave the feedback and knows what was asked. The author has merged PRs before, so the missing "help wanted" label on #30248 is not a close reason.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks, the screenshots and checklist look good. @laurynmm, could you review this?
```
